column3: NASB adds “for clothing” to “what will we wear.”
NASB renders “seek after” as “eagerly seek” and repeats “all these things” at the end.
NASB has “His kingdom” without “of God,” a reading found in some manuscripts; the critical text here has “the kingdom of God.”
“Will be anxious about itself” is rendered “will care for itself”; “sufficient to the day is its trouble” becomes “each day has enough trouble of its own.”
